name: gizza-ai/emoji-remover
summary: Strip emoji and pictographic symbols from text

tool.description: Remove emoji and pictographic symbols from text. Detection is per Unicode grapheme cluster, so ZWJ families (👨‍👩‍👧‍👦), regional-indicator flags (🇬🇧), skin-tone modifiers (👍🏽), keycaps (1️⃣), and variation selectors come out cleanly and whole. `mode` chooses what to leave behind (remove / space / placeholder + `placeholder` text); `collapse_whitespace` tidies the gaps; `keep_text_symbols` preserves text-default symbols like © ® ™ and un-styled hearts. Runs locally — the text never leaves the device.

collapse_whitespace.description: When true, collapse runs of whitespace (including gaps left where an emoji was deleted) into a single space, preserve paragraph breaks as one newline, and trim the ends. Default false.

keep_text_symbols.description: When true, keep pictographic symbols that default to text presentation (©, ®, ™, and hearts/arrows without an emoji variation selector) instead of removing them. Emoji-styled symbols (with VS16), flags, keycaps, and skin-toned/ZWJ emoji are still removed. Default false.

mode.description: What to leave in place of each removed emoji. 'remove' (default) deletes it; 'space' leaves a single space; 'placeholder' inserts the `placeholder` string.

placeholder.description: Text inserted for each removed emoji when mode is 'placeholder' (e.g. '[emoji]'). Ignored for the other modes.

text.description: The text to strip emoji and pictographic symbols from.
